Job Posting Title E Route Sales Driver-Str Tr 

 Job Description
 This role is located in Alexandria, LA 
 The Route Driver. The position involves loading, ordering, delivering, product accounting and other functions involved in servicing a variety of customers. This position is not assigned to a specific route or day.
 Monday - Friday, Weekly guarantee of $1025.
 Deliver product to customers in an efficient, timely, courteous and accurate manner.
 Ensure sufficient route inventory levels to meet customer demands while adhering to account inventory control and company distribution procedures.
 Submit all customer paperwork and deposits daily; including invoices, load orders, and handheld reports.
 Maintain proper handheld records for all accounts.
 Load or unload cases of product manually with hook, handcart or pallet-jack onto and off the truck. Ensure load is properly secured. Collect empty cases.
 Stock and/or rotate product on shelves or in cold room.
 Must be able to complete assigned route within DOT time regulations.
 Maintain a valid Class B CDL and current DOT medical card. Per Company and/or DOT regulations, report any moving violations to management immediately.
 Checks load security prior to travel and at each stop, making adjustments when needed. 
 Know and comply with all Department of Transportation regulations per the Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations handbook.
 Complete all daily DOT and customer paperwork including delivery tickets, pre and post trip inspections, driver logs, and vehicle service reports.
 Utilizing continuous improvement mindset, assist in identifying opportunities to improve processes. 
 Know and comply with all Department of Transportation regulations per the Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations handbook.
 Perform other duties as assigned.

 Job Requirements : 
 High School Diploma or GED preferred; and one to two years related experience and/or training
 Able to add, subtract, multiply and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions and decimals. 
 Experience within the food and beverage industry preferred.
 Must be able to drive, stand, walk, kneel, lift and bend required for virtually the entire shift. Balance - pulling product, climb in and out of truck. Ability to lift and/or move up to six cases on hand truck. (cases weigh 20 to 55 lbs.). 
 Must be able to work in indoor and outdoor environment with moderate noise, sometimes slippery floors. Temperature range from 34-120 degrees F. 
 Must be willing to work flexible hours including overtime, weekends and holidays. 
 Be able to effectively work in a team environment.

description:
Job Summary: 
 As a Production worker we have several opportunities to work in different areas of the plant to operate equipment. If you like to work in a fast-paced environment, have attention to detail and enjoy being part of a team this might be the perfect job for you. 
 This is a great opportunity to establish yourself in a secure company with a 75+ year history of success. We are proud to be comprised of more than 800 farm families throughout the Midwest. Since 1938, we have been producing high-quality products for you and your family. 

 Essential Duties and Responsibilities 

 Clean, set-up, operate and monitor equipment of the production line 
 Perform cleanings during set down times and product changeovers 
 Load/unload stacks and moves items as assigned 
 Sort, bundle and fill containers or place in assembled units 
 Mark or place identifying labels on product loads, ensuring that all finished product is coded properly 
 Record movement of stock in and out of work areas 
 Ability to troubleshoot and resolve basic to moderate operating difficulties 
 Monitor materials, products and equipment at each step of the process and reports irregularities to supervisor 
 Maintain communication with other departments, management and employees and notify them of any problems and/or concerns that may restrict efficiency 
 Ensure all paperwork is filled out in a clear, legible and accurate format 
 Utilizing continuous improvement mindset, assist in identifying opportunities to improve processes 
 Follow Good Manufacturing Practices 
 Follow all required work safe practices. This would include wearing of all required PPE in designated areas, confined space safety, safe chemical handling, fall restraints, etc 
 Report any food safety and food quality related issues to management immediately 
 Other duties assigned or required 

 Work Environment: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 

 While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be frequently exposed moving mechanical parts and forklifts. 
 The employee is occasionally exposed to wet / humid / cold conditions (non-weather). 
 The noise level in the work environment may be loud. 
 The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk and sit. 
 The employee may occasionally be required to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.

 Ability to exhibit a positive image and professionalism to customers.

description:
NetSuite Coordinator
 Department: Production / Operations
 Reports To: Director of Manufacturing or Designee
 FLSA Status: Non-Exempt
 Location: Garden City, NY 
 Position Summary
 The NetSuite Coordinator is responsible for supporting Production through the accurate and timely entry, review, reconciliation, and maintenance of manufacturing information within NetSuite. This position helps ensure production activity, material usage, finished goods, inventory movements, and related manufacturing transactions are accurately reflected in the system.
 The NetSuite Coordinator works closely with Production, Warehouse, Quality Assurance, Planning, Purchasing, Finance, and other departments to identify and resolve transaction discrepancies, maintain accurate production records, and support efficient manufacturing operations. This position serves as a key link between activities occurring on the production floor and the information recorded within NetSuite.
 Essential Duties and Responsibilities
 Enter, review, and maintain daily production transactions within NetSuite.
 Ensure production activity is entered accurately and within established timelines.
 Review production orders and related manufacturing transactions for completeness and accuracy.
 Record and reconcile raw material, ingredient, packaging, and finished goods usage associated with production.
 Verify production quantities, yields, material consumption, scrap, waste, and other manufacturing information as required.
 Review production documentation and compare information against transactions recorded in NetSuite.
 Identify missing, incomplete, duplicate, or inaccurate production transactions and coordinate corrections.
 Work closely with Production leadership to resolve discrepancies between actual production activity and system records.
 Coordinate with Warehouse personnel regarding inventory movements, material staging, production consumption, and finished goods transactions.
 Assist with reconciliation of production-related inventory discrepancies.
 Support accurate lot tracking and traceability within NetSuite.
 Verify appropriate lot numbers, quantities, items, and production information are entered into the system.
 Assist with production order creation, updates, completion, and closure as assigned.
 Review open production orders and follow up on incomplete or outstanding transactions.
 Assist with maintaining production-related item, routing, Bill of Materials (BOM), or system information as assigned.
 Generate production reports, saved searches, and other NetSuite reporting used to support manufacturing operations.
 Prepare daily, weekly, and periodic production reports for management.
 Assist Production leadership with gathering and analyzing information related to production output, yields, waste, downtime, and efficiency.
 Maintain organized production records and supporting documentation.
 Assist with inventory counts, cycle counts, and production-related inventory reconciliation activities.
 Support month-end inventory and production reconciliation activities as needed.
 Communicate system or transaction issues that may impact production, inventory accuracy, traceability, or financial reporting.
 Coordinate with the NetSuite Administrator or appropriate system resource when technical or system configuration issues are identified.
 Support implementation and testing of NetSuite improvements affecting Production.
 Assist with training Production personnel on proper NetSuite transactions and production documentation as assigned.
 Recommend improvements to production reporting, documentation, and NetSuite processes.
 Perform other duties as assigned.
 Production & Inventory Responsibilities
 Ensure production transactions accurately reflect activities performed on the manufacturing floor.
 Monitor production orders for timely and accurate completion.
 Support reconciliation of raw material consumption, packaging usage, finished goods production, scrap, and waste.
 Work with Production and Warehouse to investigate inventory variances.
 Maintain accurate lot and production information to support product traceability.
 Identify recurring transaction errors and work with Production leadership to improve processes and employee understanding.
 Support accurate production data used for operational and financial reporting.
 Food Safety & Quality Responsibilities
 Maintain accurate production and lot information within NetSuite to support product identification and traceability.
 Ensure production records are entered and maintained in accordance with company procedures and applicable food safety requirements.
 Immediately report discrepancies that could impact product traceability, inventory integrity, food safety, or product quality.
 Coordinate with Quality Assurance when production transactions involve product holds, releases, rejected materials, or other quality-related inventory activity.
 Support traceability exercises, mock recalls, audits, and investigations by providing accurate production and inventory information as required.
 Support compliance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), HACCP, SQF, FSMA, Food Defense, Food Fraud, Allergen Management, and Traceability requirements.
 Support the Company's commitment to producing safe, legal, authentic, and quality food products.
 Food Safety Culture
 All employees are responsible for supporting and promoting the Company's food safety culture. Employees are expected to actively participate in food safety initiatives, report concerns, follow established procedures, and contribute to the production of safe, legal, and quality food products in accordance with SQF, regulatory, customer, and company requirements.
 The NetSuite Coordinator supports the Company's food safety culture by maintaining accurate production, inventory, lot, and traceability information and promptly addressing discrepancies that could impact product integrity.
 Authority and Responsibility
 The NetSuite Coordinator has the authority and responsibility to:
 Identify and communicate incomplete or inaccurate production transactions.
 Request clarification or supporting documentation when production information cannot be accurately reconciled.
 Coordinate corrections to production transactions in accordance with established procedures.
 Escalate unresolved production, inventory, traceability, or system discrepancies to management.
 Recommend improvements to production documentation and NetSuite processes.
 Coordinate with the NetSuite Administrator regarding system-related issues requiring technical or administrative support.
 Qualifications
 Education
 High School Diploma or GED required.
 Associate's Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Accounting, Operations Management, or a related field preferred.
 Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
 Experience
 Minimum two (2) years of experience in manufacturing administration, production control, inventory control, data coordination, or a related role preferred.
 Food manufacturing experience strongly preferred.
 Experience with NetSuite or another manufacturing ERP system preferred.
 Experience working with production orders, inventory transactions, or manufacturing records preferred.
 Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
 Understanding of manufacturing and production processes.
 Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
 Ability to reconcile production documentation against system transactions.
 Understanding of inventory movement, material consumption, finished goods, and production reporting.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 Strong organizational and follow-up abilities.
 Ability to identify discrepancies and investigate transactions to determine the appropriate resolution.
 Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Microsoft Excel.
 Experience with NetSuite strongly preferred.
 Ability to communicate effectively with Production employees, supervisors, managers, and cross-functional departments.
 Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
 Competency Requirements
 Employees must demonstrate competency through a combination of education, experience, training, observation, testing, performance evaluation, and on-the-job verification as applicable to their position. Competency records shall be maintained in accordance with company training procedures.
 Training Requirements
 The NetSuite Coordinator must successfully complete all required company orientation, food safety, safety, and job-specific training programs as assigned.
 Training requirements, competency expectations, refresher training, and position-specific training matrices shall be maintained in accordance with the Company's Employee Training Requirements Program and applicable departmental training procedures.
 Physical Requirements
 Ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods.
 Ability to use computers and standard office equipment for extended periods.
 Ability to regularly walk throughout production and warehouse areas to obtain information and coordinate with operational personnel.
 Ability to occasionally lift and carry up to 25 pounds.
 Ability to wear required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
 Work Environment
 Work is performed in both office and food manufacturing environments. The position requires regular interaction with Production and Warehouse personnel and may require frequent presence on the production floor. Exposure to production equipment, moving machinery, food allergens, varying temperatures, and production noise may occur. Compliance with all company safety, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), food safety, sanitation, and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) requirements is mandatory.
 Disclaimer
 This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employees assigned to this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications required. Management reserves the right to modify, assign, or remove duties and responsibilities as business needs require.

SEKISUI Aerospace 
 Job Description 

 We are continuing to grow! We are currently accepting applications for upcoming 2nd Shift Laminator I needs at our Sumner location.
 Benefits 
 Medical (free employee only coverage and low-cost options available)
 Dental, Vision, Prescription
 Life and AD&D Insurance
 Company Sponsored 401k with Employer Match
 Employee Assistance Program
 Wellness Program
 Tuition Reimbursement
 Employee Discounts
 8 Paid Holidays plus closed (with pay) for a week during the winter break 
 15 days per year accrued Vacation/Sick time. Accrued time is available to use immediately 

 Pay: $$22.25 - $26.25/hour (full time, non-exempt)
 Schedule: 3:30 pm – 2:00 am, Monday - Thursday

 Position Summary 
 The Laminator performs a variety of techniques to laminate composite components according to drawings and Standard Work Instruction (SWI).

 Responsibilities include 
 Lay-up composite materials on mandrels according to the manufacturing plan and standard work instructions (SWI); wrap mold with composite materials, in preparation for curing process, to form composite parts.
 Check for accuracy in all prior documentation of manufacturing planning; reporting all discrepancies and schedule concerns to the supervisor.
 Verify materials being used are according to manufacturing plan.
 Verify part ID tag and sign off on work performed.
 Adhere to schedules and time allowances, takt time, for production requirements.

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Ability to read and understand detailed instructions and follow demonstrated steps.
 Basic understanding of process specifications.
 Acute attention to detail.
 Excellent hand-eye coordination.
 Excellent interpersonal skills.
 Basic math and computer skills.

 Experience 
 One year of experience directly related to the duties and responsibilities in a manufacturing environment preferred.
 Experience in composite manufacturing a plus.

 Working Conditions 
 While performing typical duties of this job, production employees will experience the conditions noted below. PPE is provided to protect employees against physical harm or hazards in the workplace environment.
 Usually work indoors. These sites may not be temperature controlled.
 Exposure to loud sounds and distracting noise levels.
 Exposure to hazardous equipment.
 Exposure to contaminants.
 Shared workspaces with other employees.
 Requires handing objects of up to 50 lbs.
 Lifting pushing, pulling, and bending.
 Standing and/or walking for 8 to 12 or more hours per day (varies based on role, shift, and overtime).

 Required PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) 
 Required PPE provided by SEKISUI Aerospace based on the employee’s position and exposure. Below are typical PPE used on the production floor. Appropriate PPE must be worn by all employees when on the production floor.
 Ear Plugs - Earmuffs
 Full Face Shield
 Gloves (Latex, Rubber, Chemical Resistant, General Duty)
 Protective Apron
 Respirator
 Safety Glasses - Safety Goggles

 Other Duties 
 This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

 About Us 
 For over 30 years SEKISUI Aerospace has been designing, testing, and manufacturing composite products for the aerospace industry. With complete customer satisfaction as our focus and through the relentless efforts of our skilled employees, SEKISUI Aerospace has achieved and continues to maintain an unequaled level of performance.
 Our consistent delivery of high-quality products demonstrates our intent, integrity, and dedication to our customers and to our reputation as a manufacturer. We will continue to insert intelligent automation into our manufacturing facilities, which will continue to drive the future of flight well into the next century.
 Learn more about us here: https://www.sekisuiaerospace.com/about 
 View all our job postings here: https://www.sekisuiaerospace.com/careers 

 Pre-Employment Drug and Background Screenings 
 SEKISUI Aerospace is a Drug-Free workplace. Pre-employment drug screen required.
 Any applicant selected for this position will be required to submit to a background screening.

 Equal Opportunity Employer 
 SEKISUI Aerospace provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

 People with Disabilities 
 SEKISUI Aerospace is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, contact the human resources department at the appropriate SEKISUI Aerospace manufacturing site.
 Please call if you need an accommodation: 
 Renton Operations, Corporate Headquarters: 425-235-2750
 Sumner Operations: 253-863-7868

 E-Verify Statement 
 SEKISUI Aerospace is a federal contractor and is required to participate in the federal government’s E-Verify program. E-Verify allows us to confirm the employment authorization of newly hired employees through an electronic database maintained by the Social Security Administration and Department of Homeland Security. With respect to new hires, the E-Verify process must be completed in conjunction with a new hire’s completion of the Form I-9, Employment Eligibility Verification, within three days of starting employment. For information regarding E-Verify, visit the E-Verify site .

 Export Control Requirements 
 This position must meet (ITAR) export control compliance requirements. To meet export control compliance requirements, a “U.S. Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. §120.15 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.

 Pay 
 SEKISUI Aerospace is required by Washington law to include the pay for this role when hiring a Washington resident. Pay may be higher or lower for non-resident WA employees, based on the market data for their region, allowing us to pay employees competitively in different geographic markets.
 Please note that the pay rate shown above is a general guideline only. Pay is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

 Our Values 
 The employees of SEKISUI Aerospace enjoy what we do and are dedicated to our seven corporate values. We promise to hold ourselves to these high standards and seek co-workers who are willing to join us in this task.

 The Mechanic's Assistant/Blaster is position that performs a variety of mechanical operations / tasks on turbomachinery components and assemblies to ensure compliance with specifications and quality requirements. Basic cleanup of the shop facilities, blasting, solvent cleaning, and painting of rotating equipment parts.
 PRIMARY ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES :
 Essential Functions :
 Maintain a safe working environment and a commitment to safety excellence.
 Responsible for understanding and complying with the safety policy, procedures and instructions.
 Maintaining a clean and organized work area.
 General mechanical helper participating in disassembly of rotating equipment.
 Hard blast and bead blast parts (with proper training).
 Steam clean and solvent clean parts.
 Tap and clean threaded holes, hone mating faces.
 Apply Belzona coatings (with proper training)
 Prep and paint parts with approved coatings (with proper training).
 General shop cleanup.
 Prep shop equipment (balance machines, lathes, mills, etc.) for painting per RMS specifications.
 Fabrication and structural welding of fixturing and skids for shop use. Blast and paint fixturing and skids per RMS specifications. 
 Tack welding of balance weights for balance technician.
 Light mechanic work with supervision of evening shift mechanic.
 Assist evening shift machinist with set ups or moving parts to and from machines.
 Assist evening shift personnel with logistic issues.
 Operate for truck (training will be provided).
 Perform other duties as required.
 Physical Requirements :
 While performing the duties of this position, the employee will be required to stand and walk for significant portions of the shift.
 Ability and willingness to lift objects weighing up to 30-50 lbs, walk, climb, kneel, crawl and balance.
 Must be able to use hands for assembly and tool usage.
 Must not have allergies or issues related to handling metals including aluminum, copper, bronze and steel.

 Ability to work in a team environment.
 Ability and willingness to work overtime, weekends and holidays as required.
 Ability and willingness to work in an environment of constant pushing, pulling, lifting, stretching, bending and other physical activities.

 Ability and willingness to work around and use large propane / acetylene torches.
 Ability to operate small lifts, pallet jacks and other lifting equipment (training will be provided on our specific equipment, but basic skills are required beforehand).

 Basic oral and written communication skills.
 Basic computer and math skills.
 Patience, attention to detail and willingness to learn. 
 Position is full-time in our Bethlehem, PA shop.
 REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS: 
 At least two years of experience working in an industrial or machine shop setting preferred.
 Minimum of two years experience with component assembly and dynamic balancing preferred.

 High School Diploma / GED from an accredited school or institution.

description:
At ServisFirst, Our Name is Our Mission. 

 DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

 The Client Associate position provides administrative support to Bank Officers, assisting with responses to client requests, scheduling appointments, coordinating resources and gathering loan documentation and related reports as needed. Assignments will depend on the local region and the individual needs of officers, who require varying degrees of assistance depending on specialty (commercial loans, executives, management duties) and technical knowledge (ex., some officers manage their own calendars, some delegate to an assistant). 

 The incumbent will perform duties in the following areas: 

 Interact directly with clients and vendors to obtain necessary loan documentation (title companies, attorneys, business owners, etc.)
 Examine documents to identify missing, incomplete, or inconsistent information such as signatures, notarization, initials, terms, etc.
 Prepare and submit loan packages for underwriting, further approval, or closing, depending on type of loan and needs of officer
 Provide ongoing relationship servicing with current clients to maintain goodwill and gain additional business
 Respond to telephone and email inquiries on behalf of the officer
 Coordinate responses among multiple parties as needed, serving as a single point of contact
 Advise the officer of client requests and seek officer approval in cases of fee waivers, overdrafts, etc.
 Schedule events such as meetings, conferences, sales appointments, etc.
 Prepare reports and distribute as appropriate
 Reserve and coordinate resources (conference rooms, catering, PCs, reports, presentations) on behalf of office
 Responsible for being familiar with all compliance regulations and policies that are applicable to this position and follow and ensure compliance with these regulations and policies 

 Note: Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable otherwise qualified associates/applicants with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

 Note: Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned

 MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS 

 High school diploma or equivalent; some college preferred
 Administrative experience; financial services environment preferred
 Experience interacting directly with clients/vendors/management/directors responding to requests and researching/resolving issues
 Proficient with Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint
 Experience coordinating shared resources and working successfully with team members 
 Knowledge of loan documents, approval process and general Bank policies and procedures
 Excellent organizational and time management skills, as demonstrated in experience handling multiple tasks and client requests within deadline

 PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS AND ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS 

 The physical requirements and environmental conditions of this position consist primarily of:

 Sustained standing and sitting
 Frequent use of PC, including typing or sustained attention to monitor 
 Occasional lifting of basic office files or equipment up to 20 lbs
 Normal office environment with comfortable internal temperatures and low level noise

 EOE/AA

description:
If you meet the minimum qualifications for this role, you could be scheduled for an interview in real time! Text "SCT" to (423) 460-8460 to apply with our recruiting assistant.
 All jobs at Southern Champion Tray (SCT) require Team members to act in accordance with the shared Core Values and Operating principles of the company as they perform specific job functions. These include: 

 • Trustworthy – We strive for our actions to match our words in all our relationships. 
 • Servant – Hearted – We enable and empower our team to serve the needs of customers, Team members, suppliers, and the community. 
 • Relationa l – We aim to build healthy relationships while fostering an environment that promotes compassion, balance, and personal and professional growth. 
 • Resourceful – We value strategic insourcing, first looking to create solutions internally, and then looking to apply that knowledge to future opportunities. 

 PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY: Works with the Shipping Clerk with regard to unloading and loading trailers, fulfilling orders, wrapping pallets, stacking, labeling, audits, and other related activities as they pertain to warehousing and fulfilling customer orders. 

 SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITY: 

 Assist in performing the shipping and receiving operation in a consistent manner as instructed in the training program. 
 Responsible for maintaining the procedures concerning operation unless the training program is changed and properly recorded concerning procedure. 
 Load and unload trailers safely in accordance with defined SCT safety policies and procedures. 
 Fulfill customer orders with the use of an RF handheld. 
 Back-up the Shipping Clerk. 
 Load the trailer accurately concerning proper sequence, products, and weight distribution as directed. 
 Operate stand-up forklift or other material handling equipment in a safe and efficient manner. 
 Restack pallets that have fallen in the warehouse and in the transfer process. 
 Unload all returned finished goods and move them to the damaged and return area. 
 Keep the work area clean and orderly, including articles that fall outside in the daily loading and unloading, primarily focusing on the shipping and staging area. 
 Report any mechanical problems with equipment or any safety hazards in the performance of your duties. 
 Maintain order in the manufacturing and warehouse storing areas in the performance of your duties. 
 Unload all deliveries or shipments from outside vendors, inspect quality, quantity, and condition of all shipments, and record paperwork. 
 Adjust to and follow new procedures and innovations, which would add to the efficiency and safety of the operation. 
 Perform daily forklift checklist and routine maintenance on equipment including cleaning equipment. 
 May be required to train new or existing employees in adherence to SCT safety and company polices. 
 Routine housekeeping to be performed daily in adherence to company policy and warehouse needs . 

 QUALIFICATIONS: 

 EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE: High school diploma or general education degree (GED); or one to three months related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience. Must have basic computer skills and possess the ability to utilize software. 

 LANGUAGE SKILLS: Must have the ability to read and understand documents, letters, etc. and write legibly in English. Must be able to understand and speak clearly, communicate, and understand directions in English as needed. 

Day Shift (3 Day/12 Hour) - 6:30 AM to 6:30 PM EST - Blue Team
Warehouse / DC - 3480 Amnicola Highway, Chattanooga, TN 37406

description:
All jobs at Southern Champion Tray (SCT) require Team members to act in accordance with the shared Core Values and Operating principles of the company as they perform specific job functions. These include: 
 Trustworthy – We strive for our actions to match our words in all our relationships. 
 Servant – Hearted – We enable and empower our team to serve the needs of our customers, team members, and community. 
 Relational – We build healthy relationships while fostering an environment of compassion, balance, accountability, and personal and professional growth. 
 Resourceful – We value strategic insourcing, first looking to create solutions internally, and then looking to apply that knowledge to future opportunities. 

 PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY: The Cutter Operator will lead and assist the team in safely setting up, maintaining, and operating the machine(s) to acquire quality product while maximizing throughput. They will also define problem statements, conduct root cause analysis, and troubleshoot mechanical issues that occur on the machine. The Operator will escalate unresolved issues to the Lead Operator or Maintenance, while remaining available to assist in order to build their capabilities in the resolution of the issue. 
 *In order to fulfill the requirements for the Cutter Operator, team members must demonstrate proficiency in the roles and responsibilities of a Cutter Apprentice and Production Assistant. 
 ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 Review job tickets to determine components, settings, and adjustments, for cutting machines 
 Examine and measure materials to verify conformance to specifications, using measuring devices such as rulers and micrometers. Verify setups and make necessary adjustments. 
 Adjust controls to alter position, alignment, speed, or pressure. 
 Maintain robotic equipment or related automated production systems. Modify computer-controlled robot movements based on job (Centre South only) 
 Work with robotic tech to make sure the Axium is set up for the upcoming job and assist the robotic tech during any issues with the Axium throughout the run (Compress location only). 
 Maintain production records, such as quantities, types, and dimensions of materials produced 
 Removed defective or substandard materials from machine and readjust machine components so that products meet standards. 
 Move stock or scrap to and from machines manually or by using carts, hand trucks or lift trucks 
 Change or replace knife, scaring rule and rubber, using hand tools and adhesives. Additionally ensure all waste is appropriately segregated by board type 
 Spend daily, intentional time with team members to know and serve them, encouraging their growth and development and providing regular feedback on their progress in training 
 Own your personal safety and that of all SCT team members by identifying, correcting, and escalating any safety hazards.) 
 Own the quality of our product, escalating and/or solving issues identified, while developing quality awareness in team members 
 Proactively communicate and collaborate with all team members (on and across shifts), Supervisor, Mechanic, and the SCT team at large. 
 Maintains a clean work environment in accordance with Food Safety, Kanban and 5S systems 
 Adapts to Continuous Improvement and follows new procedures and innovations, which would add to the efficiency and safety of the operation 
 Coordinate with Lead Operator to effectively utilize team members during machine downtime (not including approved breaks) to maintain a clean and safe work area, develop your team in areas defined by the standard work practice, or support another area in need 
 Flow to the work or need of the site with positivity, occasionally performing a different job or supporting a different department based on production needs (Ownership/Servant-hearted) 
 Serve as a backup to the Lead Operator in their absence Perform preventative maintenance tasks as scheduled by clean and lubricate cutting machine, conveyors, bundler, labeler, automation using compressed air hoses, scrapers, brushes and other greases/lubrications 

 AUTHORITY: The Cutter Operator must have the ability to lead those assigned to their team to execute the demands of the gluer operation efficiently and to respond to verbal instructions from the Lead Operator or Supervisor and other written instructions. 
 QUALIFICATIONS: 
 EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE: High school diploma or general education degree (GED); or two to three years of related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience. Must have basic computer skills and possess ability to utilize software. Must have mechanical ability and skills. 

 LANGUAGE SKILLS: Must have the ability to read and understand documents, letters, etc. and write legibly in English. Must be able to understand and speak clearly, communicate, and understand directions in English as needed.

description:
About SiTime 

 SiTime is the Precision Timing company. 

 Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. For decades, quartz devices, non-silicon technology, have kept systems in sync, but they struggle in harsher, more demanding environments. MEMS-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT. 

 Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit: www.sitime.com . 

 Job Summary 

 As a Manager of Sustaining Test Engineering, you are expected to manage the Sustaining group in Ipoh, providing technical guidance and providing directions to the team. 
 You will provide priorities and guide the project commitments of the team .
 You will drive the HW, Product and System Qualification Buy-off to be deployed for Mass Production.
 Will take project initiatives on Test improvements, Test Program releases and test program revision updates.
 Make recommendations for process improvements in production.
 Making sure that OSAT Testing for Final Test and Circuit/Wafer Probing does not have significant issues that will result in lines-down.
 You will drive Continuous improvement initiatives.

 Responsibilities: 
 Provide clear directions to the Sustaining team 
 Provide guidance to the team on solutions and dispositions to Test Engineering abnormalities in a Manufacturing/Production environment. 
 Plan and execute qualification and buy-off for but not limited to both new and mature products, HW, ATE System, Test Programs and other Testing related coverage that needs qualification and buy-off. 
 Provide Test Data Analysis and documented reports on Buy-off and Qualification data. 
 Provide remote and online debug for Product, Test Program, System and HW issues. 
 Provide technical guidance to Sustaining test engineers, such as debugging Test programs, debugging Test Hardware, FA analysis. 
 Recommend priority changes and plan resource management. 
 Interface with Internal Cross-Functional Team and OSAT personnel. 
 Travel locally or internationally to OSAT and other company offices as needed. 

 Qualifications & Requirements (Education must be included): 

 Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree or above in Engineering, Computer, Electrical, Industrial or any related field.
 Experience in managing technical teams.
 Experience with Prober and ATE Handler
 Experience with Final Test Testing and/or Wafer Sort/Circuit Probing.
 Experience on-Line Sustaining for Final Test or Circuit Probe/Wafer Sort.
 Experience with ETS-88, ETS-364 or any commercial Testers (LTX, Advantest, uFlex, iFlex etc.).
 Familiar/Knowledgeable with C++ or Python.
 Set-up experience and verification on Testing Hardware e.g. Probe Card, Load Board, Circuit Interface board.
 English communication proficiency.

 Desired Characteristics & Attributes: 

 Leader
 Team Player
 Resilient and has a strong motivation to grow professionally
 Fast Learner and Independent
 Highly motivated
 Compassionate
 Patience

 Compensation Range: 

 At SiTime, we believe great work deserves great rewards. We offer a comprehensive and highly competitive compensation package designed to attract top talent. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for a quarterly bonus tied to the achievement of innovation goals—reflecting our commitment to recognizing meaningful impact. We also offer equity grants, providing a meaningful opportunity to share in the company’s future growth and success. 

 SiTime is an Equal Opportunity Employer . We treat each person fairly and we do not tolerate discrimination or harassment against anyone on the basis of any protected characteristics, including race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy, political affiliation, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, or marital status or other characteristics protected by law. SiTime participates in the E-Verify program. 
 Learn More about SiTime: Review the Get to Know SiTime section of our career page to explore our culture, values, and what makes us unique.

Community Manager 
 Masselin Park West Apartments | Los Angeles, CA 
 We are seeking an experienced and customer‑focused Community Manager to lead operations at Masselin Park West Apartments in Los Angeles, CA. This role is responsible for driving strong financial and operational performance, ensuring regulatory compliance, and creating a positive and engaging resident experience. 

 The Community Manager leads the on‑site team, oversees leasing and maintenance operations, manages budgets, and partners closely with regional leadership to maintain high occupancy and a thriving community environment. 

 Key Responsibilities 
 Train, motivate, and lead a high‑performing on‑site team. 
 Recruit, interview, hire, coach, and manage employees in accordance with company policies, under the guidance of the Regional Property Supervisor and Human Resources. 
 Provide timely, objective feedback and complete annual performance reviews. 
 Promote a professional, friendly, and respectful work environment for residents, vendors, and team members. 
 Coordinate and manage on‑site staff scheduling. 
 Ensure accurate reporting of employee time and work records. 
 Administer and maintain compliance with the Company’s Injury and Illness Prevention Program (IIPP). 
 Resolve resident concerns promptly and professionally. 
 Develop and support resident retention initiatives. 
 Ensure required reports are completed accurately and submitted on time. 
 Maintain online marketing efforts, advertising content, pricing, availability, and specials to maximize occupancy.

description:
Join Southpointe Animal Hospital as a Client Ambassador! 
 Part of the Veterinary United Family 

 Are you passionate about animals and ready to start a career in Veterinary Medicine? Join Veterinary United, where our dedicated team of animal wellness advocates is transforming veterinary care for the better. As part of our team, you’ll contribute to a supportive and positive environment that delivers individual care to every patient and client, while also making a meaningful impact in our communities. 
 Be a Pawsitive Influence! 
 The ideal candidate will be pet- and people-friendly, energetic, and eager to help create the best experience for every pet and their owner. As the first point of contact, you'll bring warmth and positivity to every interaction, setting the tone for exceptional customer service. Your love for animals of all kinds will shine through as you grow in a field that combines compassion with continuous learning and growth. 

 Role Overview: Client Ambassador 
 As a Client Ambassador, you'll support the hospital’s daily operations and create an inviting and efficient front desk experience. You will: 
 Warmly greet clients and pets upon arrival. 
 Answer multi-line phones, schedule appointments, and update medical charts. 
 Process monetary transactions and handle client payments. 
 Assist with administrative tasks such as filing, data entry, stocking, scanning, and uploading records. 
 Support kennel and boarding staff as needed with dog walking, feeding, and check-in/check-out. 
 Maintain a clean and organized reception area to ensure a welcoming space. 
 Qualifications 
 High School Diploma or GED. 
 1+ year of prior customer service experience. 
 Reception experience highly preferred. 
 Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. without restriction. 
 Comfortable working around animals, including those that may be anxious or aggressive. 
 Physical Requirements: Must be able to stand, sit, and move frequently; bend, kneel, and stretch as needed to assist pets and clients; and maintain composure and control in a dynamic, high-energy environment. 

 Why Join Veterinary United? 
 At Veterinary United, we believe in teamwork, growth, and fostering a positive culture. We aim to be changemakers in veterinary medicine, building a better future for our hospitals, teams, and clients. If you’re open to growth, positivity, and making a difference in the veterinary field, Veterinary United is the perfect place for you! 
 Ready to be part of something bigger? Apply today and become a changemaker with Veterinary United! 

 Veterinary United’s Commitment to their Team: 
 Inspire and encourage a culture of teamwork and collaboration. 
 Empower team members to embrace our culture of kindness and choose an environment of positivity and joy. 
 Lead the teams to model, identify, exemplify, and amplify leadership. 
 Believe and achieve; a growth mindset for yourself, for your team, and for veterinary medicine. 
 Evolve to create opportunities to embrace efforts of team building, fun, and camaraderie.

description:
Make a meaningful contribution everyday as a Full-Time Long-Term Care CNA (Night-Shift)! 
 Bring compassion to where it matters most. As a Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) in Long-Term Care, you’ll provide essential, hands-on care that supports our residents’ comfort, dignity, and quality of life every day. If you take pride in building meaningful connections, delivering dependable care, and being part of a team that truly values patients and one another, this is a role where your work makes a lasting difference. Willingness to cross-train and support our Acute Care team is highly valued, as we work together to provide exceptional care across our organization. 
 At Weston County Health Services, we recognize the critical role our bedside caregivers play every day and we’re investing in you 
 If you’re looking for a place where your work is valued and rewarded, we’d love to meet you. 
 Compensation : starting at $18.00/hour depending on experience 
 Currently offering: 
 🤝 Referral Bonuses for helping us grow our team
 💰 Sign-On Bonuses for new hires
 For the CNA role, you have the opportunity to earn a sign-on bonus of $ 1,500 , with a 50% payment at hire and the remainder at 6 months. 
 Refer someone and receive $ 1,500 for a CNA, $ 2,000 for a LPN, and $ 3,000 for an RN, with 50% payment at hire and the remainder at 6 months. 
 Why You’ll Love Working Here 
 Competitive compensation and benefits package
 Shift differentials 
 Supportive, collaborative team environment
 Opportunities for growth and professional development (including scholarships and training)
 Paid Personal Leave (PPL): begins accruing on your first day and can be used after 90 days of employment
 Health insurance: coverage begins the first day of the month following hire
 Dental and vision insurance begins the first day of the month following hire
 Life insurance: coverage begins the first day of the month following hire
 Supplemental insurance options, including accident, short-term, and long-term disability
 Bereavement leave
 What You’ll Do 
 Respond promptly to patient call lights and assess needs to determine appropriate support or escalation
 Provide hands-on assistance with activities of daily living (ADLs), including mobility, personal hygiene, and comfort care
 Turn, reposition, and assist bedridden patients per care plans and safety guidelines
 Support nutritional needs by following dietary restrictions, food allergies, and resident preferences
 Gather and communicate relevant information regarding patient condition, treatment plans, and recommended activities
 Measure, monitor, and accurately record food and fluid intake
 Obtain and document vital signs, including blood pressure, pulse, temperature, and respirations, as directed
 Observe patients for changes in condition or signs requiring medical attention and report findings to nursing staff
 Communicate patients concerns, complaints, or symptoms clearly and promptly to nurses
 Greet and assist patients, families, and visitors professionally, providing directions and support as needed
 Introduce yourself to patients, families, and visitors to promote comfort and trust
 Identify and report safety hazards to ensure a safe care environment
 Replenish supplies and maintain organized patient care areas
 Adhere to all infection control practices, including proper hand hygiene, standard precautions, and isolation protocols
 What We’re Looking For 
 Wyoming State Certified Nursing Assistant
 High School Diploma or equivalent
 Exceptional knowledge of medical terminology and processes.
 Has and maintains Basic Life Support (BLS) Certification.
 Strong written and oral communication skills
 Willingness to take after-hours calls, work nights, weekends, pick up shifts, and flexibility in scheduling, due to patient care needs.
 Willing to cross-train and support staffing needs across departments, including picking up shifts in acute care
 Physical Requirements and Conditions 
 This position requires light to moderate work with 50 pounds maximum weight to lift and carry.
 Position requires reaching, bending, stooping, and handling objects with hands and/or fingers, talking and/or hearing, and seeing.
